scope: HOST-only owned passive-probe staging and preservation/removal preparation; no production activation
behavior: One separate owner-bound exact probe file; source/native/compile associations checked before staging.
Exact existing command-lock descriptor and original owner/absence callbacks required around operations.
Complete binary and stage receipt preserved before removal after independently verified stop.
Normal and failed modes both return probe cleanup facts; no automatic guard release or hidden replay.
Parent and execution carrier require the exact stage receipt; unexpected content, drift, partial cleanup or reappearance refuses further progress.
coverage: Real filesystem and lock operations only in private temporary fixtures.
Existing namespace/evidence, wrong owner/body/path, symlink root, wrong/competing lock descriptors and callback failures.
Preservation-before-removal, failed-copy refusal, ownership/body change and interruption after unlink.
Normal/held-mode distinction, source/copy drift, reappearance and refusal to adopt exit/release/retry claims.
